periods.analysis: Q1 actions: Designed a listening session guide and short survey, and held three sessions in East Flats with 40 residents. Partners: Coastal Behavioral Health, United Way of the Harbor Region.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Hold sessions in Riverside and Old Ferry Road and with faith partners.

periods.analysis: Q2 actions: Held five more sessions in Riverside, Old Ferry Road and two congregations. Cost and work schedules are the barriers residents mention most. Partners: Coastal Behavioral Health, United Way of the Harbor Region, faith partners.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Continue listening sessions, reach 150 survey responses, and ask clinics to answer the schedule barrier with evening walk-in hours.

periods.analysis: Q3 actions: Held 14 listening sessions with 210 residents and gathered 160 short surveys. The top barriers were cost, work schedules, and fear of judgment, and clinics responded by adding two evening walk-in hours. Partners: Coastal Behavioral Health, United Way of the Harbor Region, faith partners.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Publish a plain-language What We Heard report and fund a transportation option in the neighborhoods that raised it.
